test_title: PYST 26: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 10 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Hysterical
solution: The correct answer is '**controlled**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate **antonym** of the given word '**Hysterical**' is '**Controlled**'. • **Hysterical**: very excited and unable to control your emotions. [अत्‍यंत उत्तेजित (जिसका भावनाओं पर नियंत्रण नहीं रहा), उन्‍मादग्रस्‍त] • *Example: **hysterical** laughter...* • **Controlled**: to have power and ability to make somebody/something do what you want. [(किसी पर) नियंत्रण रखना] • *Example: Police struggled to **control** the crowd.* **Correct Answer:__** *controlled.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Resolute**: having or showing great determination. (दृढ़निश्‍चयी, कृतसंकल्‍प) • **Shy**: nervous and uncomfortable about meeting and speaking to people; showing that somebody feels like this. (लोगों से मिलने और बात करने में घबराहट और बेचैनी अनुभव करने वाला; संकोची, शरमीला, झेंपू; संकोच दिखाने वाला) 43:T80c, The correct answer is **'To his heart's content'.**
